checks.name: Produce Visual & Texture Condition
checks.pass_rule: Produce is fresh and firm with no mold, rot, or heavy bruising.
checks.on_fail: Quarantine affected crates immediately, log spoilage, and raise supplier credit or rejection if batch damage is widespread.

checks.name: Cold Chain Storage Temperature
checks.pass_rule: Chilled produce temperature is between 34.0°F and 38.0°F (1.1°C to 3.3°C).
checks.on_fail: Flag temperature breach, place batch on hold, and notify store manager before releasing to shelves or cooler.

checks.name: Remaining Shelf-Life & Freshness Window
checks.pass_rule: At least 3 days of usable freshness/shelf life remain from delivery date.
checks.on_fail: If 1-2 days remain on sound stock, mark for fast-sale/discount; if expired or spoiled, reject and log waste.

checks.name: Packaging Integrity & Organic Lot Labeling
checks.pass_rule: Crates/seals are intact without leaks/contamination, and organic origin/lot labels are present.
checks.on_fail: Hold unlabelled or damaged-seal crates and request organic certification/lot verification from the supplier.

checks.name: Delivered Quantity vs. Order Tolerance
checks.pass_rule: Actual delivered weight or count is within +/-5.0% of the approved purchase order.
checks.on_fail: Record quantity variance on receiving slip and log supplier short-delivery or over-delivery adjustment.
